changelog.summary: Adds optional featured images to the Generic CMS editor: choose an existing QDN image, upload a local image, preview, replace or remove it, and see the exact image that will be published. Resolution is deterministic: explicit selection, then a preserved WordPress featured image, then the first suitable image in the post body, then none. Tracking pixels, icons, SVG placeholders, video thumbnails and broken refs are skipped. The image is persisted in the native index, the qms-qdn-content@1 media document and the WordPress edit overlay, reused by content hash, and rendered on home cards, lists, detail and search. Also hardens the slug fix: the Admin shows the template version and a stale-deployment warning, and Save draft/Publish refuse an untouched one-character automatic slug from a longer title while preserving legitimate short and manually chosen slugs. Fixes the media-map array normalization that produced the URL '0' for catalog media.

desktop.changelog: Rebuilt with CMS 0.8.0-alpha.8. Desktop sources are otherwise unchanged; the desktop artifact carries the new CMS template, featured-image editor and slug guard, and the new release identity.

publisher.changelog: Unchanged in this release; the Publisher artifact is byte-identical to 0.8.0-alpha.2.

cms.changelog: CMS 0.8.0-alpha.8: optional featured images with existing-QDN selection, device upload, preview, replace, remove and deterministic first-suitable-body-image fallback; explicit WordPress featured images preserved; persistence in the native index, qms-qdn-content@1 media.featured and the edit overlay; reuse by content hash; rendering on home cards, lists, detail and search; fee quote includes a new image resource. Adds visible template version and stale-deployment guidance, refuses an untouched one-character automatic slug from a longer title while preserving legitimate short and manual slugs, and fixes media-map array normalization. Includes all CMS 0.8.0-alpha.7/6/5 fixes. See docs/migration-studio/CMS-EDITING-AND-SLUGS.md.
